question.text: Will Nueva Pescanova's octopus farm gain regulatory approval in the Canary Islands before June 2027?
question.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as **Yes** if, before June 1, 2027, [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) report that Nueva Pescanova has been officially granted regulatory approval by [the Government of the Canary Islands](https://www.gobiernodecanarias.org/principal/) to operate an octopus farm in the Canary Islands.
question.fine_print:
To qualify, the regulatory approval must be for a facility operated by Nueva Pescanova with the purpose of the production, processing, and distribution of octopuses for human consumption.

The farm does not need to be operational for this question to resolve as Yes.

research:
Nueva Pescanova withdrew its octopus farm project in the Canary Islands on 2026-07-23. As of today no application is pending there, and I found no report of any approval or new proposal anywhere in the Canaries.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question points to the Government of the Canary Islands, but there is no data series or official tracker for this. I found no Canary government page, official bulletin entry or decision that grants Nueva Pescanova approval for an octopus farm.
- 2023: the Canary government required a full ("ordinary") environmental impact assessment, because the simplified one found possible significant adverse effects. Reported problems included odours and worse water quality in the port. The company never submitted the full assessment. [Infobae](https://www.infobae.com/espana/2026/08/05/la-primera-granja-de-pulpos-del-mundo-finalmente-no-estara-en-espana-nueva-pescanova-abandona-su-polemico-proyecto-en-gran-canaria/), [elDiario.es](https://www.eldiario.es/canariasahora/ciencia_y_medio_ambiente/granja-pulpos-canarias-continua-evaluacion-ambiental-hallarse-posibles-efectos-adversos-significativos_1_11323860.html)

## 2. Current status
- 2026-07-23: Nueva Pescanova told the Las Palmas Port Authority it was withdrawing its 2021 concession request for the site at La Esfinge dock, Port of Las Palmas (about 52,691 m², planned at roughly 1 million octopuses a year). It withdrew before any final decision. [Estrella Digital](https://www.estrelladigital.es/articulo/empresas/nueva-pescanova-renuncia-construir-canarias-primera-granja-industrial-pulpos-mundo/20260804211132449546.html), [weareaquaculture](https://weareaquaculture.com/news/aquaculture/nueva-pescanova-withdraws-plans-for-the-worlds-first-octopus-farm)
- The Port Authority confirmed it would archive the 2021 file. Port Authority president Beatriz Calzada said the company found it "technically complicated" to meet all the conditions. [Infobae](https://www.infobae.com/espana/2026/08/05/la-primera-granja-de-pulpos-del-mundo-finalmente-no-estara-en-espana-nueva-pescanova-abandona-su-polemico-proyecto-en-gran-canaria/)
- The company gave "business and administrative" reasons. It said the withdrawal does not mean the farm was unviable, and it does not rule out a different location, size or technology later. It named no site and gave no timeline. [Estrella Digital](https://www.estrelladigital.es/articulo/empresas/nueva-pescanova-renuncia-construir-canarias-primera-granja-industrial-pulpos-mundo/20260804211132449546.html)
- For a Yes, the company would need to file a new or revived application in the Canaries and get it approved, including a full environmental assessment, in about 6 months. I found no sign of a new application.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-17: Nueva Pescanova launched "OptimIA", an AI platform for its Galicia plants. The coverage does not mention octopus or the Canaries. [Europa Press](https://www.europapress.es/galicia/digital-01089/noticia-nueva-pescanova-pone-marcha-plataforma-tecnologica-basada-ia-optimizar-procesos-industriales-20261117130655.html)
- Late September 2026: the Spanish bill to ban octopus aquaculture is still not law. The campaign group INTERCIDS is pushing for a vote. [Ecoticias](https://www.ecoticias.com/?p=496446)
- 2026-08-04/05: Wider press coverage of the withdrawal. [Infobae](https://www.infobae.com/espana/2026/08/05/la-primera-granja-de-pulpos-del-mundo-finalmente-no-estara-en-espana-nueva-pescanova-abandona-su-polemico-proyecto-en-gran-canaria/), [Seafood Source](https://www.seafoodsource.com/news/ngos-celebrate-as-nueva-pescanova-ditches-plans-for-octopus-farm), [Fish Farmer](https://www.fishfarmermagazine.com/news/campaigners-hail-victory-over-spanish-octopus-farm-plan)
- 2026-07-24: The animal rights party PACMA called it the definitive end of the project. [PACMA](https://pacma.es/notas-de-prensa/pacma-celebra-el-carpetazo-definitivo-al-proyecto-de-granja-de-pulpos-de-nueva-pescanova-en-gran-canaria/)
- May 2026: The Port Authority started proceedings to declare the inactive concession file expired. [Infobae](https://www.infobae.com/espana/2026/08/05/la-primera-granja-de-pulpos-del-mundo-finalmente-no-estara-en-espana-nueva-pescanova-abandona-su-polemico-proyecto-en-gran-canaria/)
- January 2026: The permit procedure for wastewater discharge was declared expired. [Infobae](https://www.infobae.com/espana/2026/08/05/la-primera-granja-de-pulpos-del-mundo-finalmente-no-estara-en-espana-nueva-pescanova-abandona-su-polemico-proyecto-en-gran-canaria/)
- 2026-05-08: Spain's octopus rules (minimum sale weight, and a push to ban intensive farming) were reported as tightening. [El Español](https://www.elespanol.com/ciencia/20260508/espana-endurece-limites-pulpo-fija-ley-peso-minimo-venta-busca-vetar-cria-intensiva-granjas/1003744232604_0.html)

## 4. Base rates
- No commercial octopus farm has been approved in the Canaries since the plan became public in 2021. That is about 5 years with no approval, and the project then ended by withdrawal.
- In Spain, a full environmental assessment for a major aquaculture concession usually takes well over a year from submission to decision, and it starts only after the company submits the study. This is a general observation, not a sourced statistic for this case.
- Many jurisdictions are moving against octopus farming: Washington and California banned it, and bills were filed in Mexico (2026-02-25) and Chile. [Mexico Daily Post](https://mexicodailypost.news/2026/03/11/why-mexico-is-seeking-to-ban-octopus-farms-before-the-industry-even-exists)
- AnimaNaturalis says Galicia's regional government has licensed similar small projects, but those would not count here because they are outside the Canaries. [Infobae](https://www.infobae.com/espana/2026/08/05/la-primera-granja-de-pulpos-del-mundo-finalmente-no-estara-en-espana-nueva-pescanova-abandona-su-polemico-proyecto-en-gran-canaria/)

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on this question, and no Metaculus community figure was supplied.
- The markets supplied with the question do not match it. The closest is Kalshi's 2027 Canary election winner (PSOE 0.58, CC 0.35, PP 0.06). That is only indirectly relevant: the election would likely be in May 2027, and a new government would not take office before the deadline.

## 6. Upcoming events before 2027-06-01
- A new application by Nueva Pescanova in the Canaries would be the necessary first step. None has been announced.
- The Spanish Congress could debate whether to take up the ban bill (filed by Sumar and allies). It was admitted for processing in June 2025 and Esquerra Republicana (ERC) withdrew its signature in September 2025. No date is set. [abogacia.es](https://www.abogacia.es/publicaciones/blogs/blog-de-derecho-de-los-animales/prohibir-las-granjas-de-pulpos-en-espana-el-momento-es-ahora/), [BOCG](https://www.congreso.es/public_oficiales/L15/CONG/BOCG/B/BOCG-15-B-241-1.PDF)
- The Canary regional election is likely on 2027-05-23.
- Nueva Pescanova's results or strategy updates (full-year 2026 results are probably due in early 2027) might say whether it will try octopus farming again.

- No commercial octopus farm has ever been approved anywhere in the Canary Islands or the EU, as far as I could find.
- Timeline: the concession request was filed in 2021, the government demanded the full assessment in 2023, and the file sat with no progress through 2026. That is five years without an approval, which suggests a new full assessment would take far longer than the roughly six months left before June 2027.

Another source says ERC withdrew its signature in September 2025. If passed, it would block approval. [BOCG](https://www.congreso.es/public_oficiales/L15/CONG/BOCG/B/BOCG-15-B-241-1.PDF)

- Cooke has a stake in Nueva Pescanova and is buying the aquaculture company Avramar. Spain's competition regulator (CNMC) is reviewing that deal, and the canning association Anfaco objected on 2026-11-18. I found no octopus angle. - Any company statement after August 2026 about octopus farming.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) About 6.4 months remain (today 2026-11-19, deadline 2027-06-01). For Yes, credible sources must report that the Government of the Canary Islands has officially approved a Nueva Pescanova facility in the Canaries for producing octopus for human consumption.

(b) The status quo is No. Nueva Pescanova withdrew its 2021 La Esfinge concession request on 2026-07-23, so there is no file pending. The required full environmental assessment was never submitted.

(c) Base rate: the reference class is withdrawn, controversial aquaculture or industrial projects that are revived and fully approved within about 10 months of withdrawal. Such cases are very rare, under 2%. No commercial octopus farm has ever been approved in the EU.

(d) Evidence:
- **For Yes (weak):** in August 2026 the company said the withdrawal did not mean the farm was unviable. It did not rule out a different site, size or technology in the future. It still holds the breeding technology.
- **For No (strong):**
  - Withdrawal on 2026-07-23, with the Port Authority archiving the file.
  - The discharge permit procedure lapsed in January 2026.
  - In 2023 the Canary government required an ordinary environmental impact assessment, which normally takes more than a year after submission.
  - There has been no new application since then. The company's November 2026 news (OptimIA) does not mention octopus.
  - A Spanish ban bill is pending, and the political climate is hostile.

(e) Scenarios:
- **No:** the company stays out of the Canaries, focuses on its Galicia operations and the Cooke and Avramar dealings, and nothing is filed or approved before June 2027. This is the overwhelmingly likely path.
- **Yes:** the company quietly files a small, reconfigured project with a complete environmental study. The Canary government fast-tracks it and approves it before the May 2027 election. This is implausible given assessment timelines and political optics.

(f) I start from a base rate of about 1-2% and see no evidence of revival. I stay at about 1%. The outcome is effectively decided because the timeline cannot realistically accommodate a new application plus a full assessment.

Probability: 1%
